name: First Light Breakfast Blend
notes: Milk chocolate, toasted almond, brown sugar
short: Our everyday cup. Smooth, sweet and forgiving, whether you brew it in a drip machine, a French press or the office pot.
long:
First Light is the coffee we drink most mornings, so we built it to be easy to like. Brazilian and Colombian beans give it a round, chocolatey base, and a medium roast keeps it sweet without a bitter finish.

It's a forgiving coffee. Grind it a little off or let it sit on the burner a few minutes too long, and it still tastes like coffee should. That makes it a good fit for drip machines, French presses and anyone who doesn't want to weigh their beans before 7am.

Tasting notes

Milk chocolate, toasted almond, brown sugar.

Brew it

  • Drip: 60g coffee to 1L water, medium grind
  • French press: 30g to 500ml, coarse grind, 4 minutes

Details

  • Origin: Brazil and Colombia
  • Roast: Medium
  • Bag: 340g whole bean or ground
  • Roasted to order and shipped within 2 business days

name: Ridgeback Espresso
short: A syrupy, chocolate-forward espresso that holds its own under steamed milk. Built for lattes, flat whites and moka pots.
long:
Ridgeback is our answer to the question we hear most from home espresso drinkers: "Why does my latte taste like warm milk?" Usually the coffee is too light to cut through. Ridgeback is roasted a shade darker to build body and sweetness, with a little cherry brightness so straight shots don't taste flat.

Pull it as a double for a thick, syrupy shot, or brew it in a moka pot for something close to espresso without the machine.

Tasting notes

Dark chocolate, cherry, molasses.

Brew it

  • Espresso: 18g in, about 36g out, 27 to 32 seconds
  • Moka pot: fill the basket level, fine-medium grind, medium heat

Details

  • Origin: Brazil, Guatemala and Ethiopia
  • Roast: Medium-dark
  • Bag: 340g whole bean or ground
  • Best 7 to 21 days after the roast date printed on the bag

name: Ethiopia Guji Natural
short: Bright and fruit-heavy, with a blueberry note you can smell from across the kitchen. A great first step into light-roast coffee.
long:
If you've ever wondered what people mean when they say coffee tastes like fruit, start here. These beans are dried inside the whole coffee cherry (the "natural" process), which pushes a jammy blueberry sweetness into the cup.

We roast it light to keep that fruit front and centre. It shines as pour-over or AeroPress, and it makes a surprisingly good cold brew.

Tasting notes

Blueberry, jasmine, dark chocolate.

Brew it

  • Pour-over: 20g to 320g water at 94°C, medium-fine grind, 3 minutes total
  • Cold brew: 100g to 1L cold water, coarse grind, 16 hours in the fridge

Details

  • Origin: Guji zone, Ethiopia
  • Process: Natural
  • Altitude: 1,900 to 2,200 m
  • Roast: Light
  • Bag: 340g whole bean or ground

name: Colombia Huila
short: Balanced and sweet, with a crisp red-apple finish. The single origin for people who like their coffee to taste like coffee.
long:
Huila's high-altitude farms grow some of Colombia's sweetest coffee. This lot is clean and balanced, with a caramel body and a crisp apple note on the finish that keeps every sip interesting.

It works with almost any brewer. If you're moving up from grocery-store coffee and want to taste the difference without anything too wild, this is the bag.

Tasting notes

Red apple, caramel, cocoa.

Details

  • Origin: Huila, Colombia
  • Process: Washed
  • Roast: Medium
  • Bag: 340g whole bean or ground

name: Guatemala Huehuetenango
short: Toffee sweetness with a bright twist of orange. Lovely black, and just as good with a splash of milk.
long:
Grown in the highlands near the Mexican border, coffee from Huehuetenango is known for its sweetness and bright acidity. This lot tastes like toffee and roasted hazelnut, with an orange note that lifts it as it cools.

Brew it in a Chemex or a drip machine and drink the whole pot. It doesn't go flat the way darker coffees can.

Tasting notes

Toffee, orange, roasted hazelnut.

Details

  • Origin: Huehuetenango, Guatemala
  • Process: Washed
  • Roast: Medium
  • Bag: 340g whole bean or ground

name: Night Owl Decaf
short: Decaf that doesn't taste like a compromise. Decaffeinated with only water, no chemical solvents, and roasted for sweetness.
long:
Most decaf tastes like cardboard because it starts as an afterthought. Night Owl starts with good Peruvian beans, which are decaffeinated with a water-only process (just water, temperature and time, no chemical solvents) and then roasted to bring out cocoa and maple sweetness.

Drink it after dinner, in the afternoon, or all day if caffeine isn't your friend. Nobody at the table will guess it's decaf.

Tasting notes

Cocoa, graham cracker, maple.

Details

  • Origin: Peru
  • Decaf method: water process, 99.9% caffeine-free
  • Roast: Medium
  • Bag: 340g whole bean or ground

name: Roaster's Sampler
short: Three 120g bags (a blend, a single origin and our current favourite) in a gift-ready box. The easiest way to find your coffee.
long:
Can't decide? Don't. The sampler includes three 120g bags: First Light Breakfast Blend, one rotating single origin and whatever the roaster is most excited about this month. Each comes with a tasting card, so you can tell what you like and why.

It also makes the easiest gift for a coffee person you can't shop for. It comes in a kraft gift box, and you can add a note at checkout.

What's inside

  • First Light Breakfast Blend, 120g
  • Rotating single origin, 120g
  • Roaster's pick, 120g
  • Tasting cards for all three

name: Ceramic Pour-Over Dripper
short: A heavy ceramic cone that holds its heat, so your pour-over brews evenly. Fits standard #2 cone filters.
long:
Pour-over is the simplest way to taste the difference between coffees, and this dripper is the simplest way to start. The thick ceramic walls hold heat, so the water temperature stays steady while you pour, and the spiral ribs let air escape for an even extraction.

Set it on any mug or carafe, drop in a #2 cone filter and pour. Pair it with the Ethiopia Guji to see what all the fuss is about.

Details

  • Material: glazed ceramic
  • Fits: standard #2 cone filters
  • Makes: 1 to 3 cups
  • Dishwasher safe
